Read it through `GET /api/v1/ads/proposal` like every other proposal, unless `preview` already carries that answer.
The card and Accept preview (S10, `agenticOfferPreviewSchema`). A malformed one is dropped, never a reason to refuse the offer.
entries.title: Shared/Core update: agentic-offer

ai.title: Agentic offer preview version 1 added
ai.summary: Adds `AGENTIC_OFFER_PREVIEW_VERSION` and `agenticOfferPreviewSchema` to `common/src/ads/agentic-offer.ts` to support embedding a proposal's card and Accept preview in the agentic offer response. The `agenticOfferRequestSchema` accepts an optional `offerPreviewVersion: 1` to signal client support for this feature, allowing the offer to carry the same data currently fetched via `GET /api/v1/ads/proposal` and `GET /api/v1/ads/proposal/{id}/accept`. This enables a single POST for acceptance without a second read when the preview is valid.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/ads/agentic-offer.ts`, the diff adds `AGENTIC_OFFER_PREVIEW_VERSION`, `agenticOfferPreviewSchema`, and the `offerPreviewVersion` field to `agenticOfferRequestSchema`, embedding a preview of proposal details directly into the agentic offer response for S10.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not specify which server-side logic triggers the inclusion of the `preview` field in the response, only that it is sent to requests with `offerPreviewVersion: 1`.

eli5.text: Freebuff can now send the full details of a sponsored task to the assistant in a single step instead of requiring two separate requests, allowing you to accept an ad-funded coding task without waiting for additional information. This internal improvement to the communication between the ad system and the assistant applies to users who see these sponsored offers, making the acceptance process faster and smoother. No action is needed on your part; the change only takes effect when you encounter a task that supports this new preview format.
